seo.title: Spotify: Discover Weekly - 100B+ tracks streamed in 10 years (2015)
seo.meta_description: Spotify's Discover Weekly algorithmic playlist has driven more than 100 billion tracks streamed since 2015 and gets users listening more than 2x as long.
seo.resume_citable: Discover Weekly, Spotify's personalized weekly playlist launched in 2015, has accumulated more than 100 billion tracks streamed and gets its users listening more than twice as long.

faq.q: How many streams has Discover Weekly generated?
faq.a: More than 100 billion tracks streamed since its 2015 launch, according to Spotify's June 2025 anniversary press release.
A 30-track playlist delivered every Monday, built through collaborative filtering, audio analysis, and listening history.

objectif_business: Make music discovery automatic and effortless, to anchor the habit of opening Spotify every week and increase listening time and loyalty against competing platforms.
description: Every Monday, Spotify delivers a playlist of 30 tracks the listener has not yet heard but is likely to enjoy. The system combines collaborative filtering (what similar profiles listen to), audio content analysis, and listening history. The playlist regenerates every week, with no action from the user. Since 2025, the listener can filter Discover Weekly by genre.
points_cles: Weekly playlist of 30 discovery tracks, regenerated every Monday with no action.
In-house collaborative filtering and audio analysis on listening history.
More than 100 billion tracks streamed, listening more than 2x longer.
Evidence B, confirmed status, feature active since 2015 (10-year press release).

niveau_preuve.justification: Figures published by Spotify (10-year newsroom, and Spotify advertising unit) on a feature in production since 2015. Direct figures from the subject brand, cumulative volume verifiable over time, without going through financial results.

stack_technique.detail: matching profiles by co-listening to predict tracks never heard but likely
audio features of tracks, complementing collaborative filtering where co-listening is missing (new releases, niches)
regeneration of the 30-track playlist every Monday for each listener, with no action on their part

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Weekly batch: one new playlist per listener every Monday.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The listener's listening history and co-listening patterns between similar profiles. Without recent listening data, collaborative filtering has nothing to match the listener to other profiles.

etapes.detail: The week's listens, followed playlists, and skipped tracks are consolidated per profile.
Collaborative filtering and audio analysis produce a list of tracks never heard but likely.
The system selects 30 tracks, ordered for the listener, delivered on Monday.
What the listener plays, saves, or skips in the playlist refines the following week.

prerequis_data: catalog with audio features or metadata
sufficient user volume for collaborative filtering
prerequis_orga: product surface to expose the playlist
replication.equipe: 2 data scientists + 1 data engineer + 1 product PM

playbook.action: Check the volume of signal: enough cross usage (active users, co-consumption) for collaborative filtering to produce candidates
Consolidate histories: listens, saves, and skips per profile in a reliable pipeline
Build the candidate model: collaborative filtering + content features to score items never consumed
playbook.livrable: Scored candidate list per user, evaluated offline

playbook.action: Assemble the playlist (30 ordered items) and deliver it in a dedicated product surface, on a fixed day
playbook.livrable: Weekly playlist in beta on a segment

playbook.action: Close the feedback loop: re-inject listens, saves, and skips, measure retention and listening time against a control
playbook.livrable: Active learning loop and impact reading

replication.premiere_etape: Confirm there is enough cross listening volume for collaborative filtering to produce relevant candidates.

statut_vivant.note: Feature still active after 10 years, enhanced in 2025 with genre filters. Spotify anniversary press release of June 30, 2025.

transposable_ue.note: Recommendation on first-party listening data; profiling subject to GDPR but standard for a streaming service. Already operated in Spotify's EU markets since 2015.
